lines.t:
A display of the force stored in the <c:ffff00>{{medal}}<c>. It rises
when you <c:ffff00>charge<c>, take <c:ffff00>{{damage}}<c>, and under
conditions specific to each <c:ffff00>{{robattle_style}}<c>.
As it fills, some <c:ffff00>{{stats}}<c> of each <c:ffff00>{{part}}<c> rise:
  <c:ffff00>Striking<c>: <c:ffff00>{{power}}<c>; <c:ffff00>{{shooting}}<c>: <c:ffff00>{{success}}<c>;
  <c:ffff00>Support<c>/<c:ffff00>Set-up<c>: <c:ffff00>{{cooldown}}<c>; <c:ffff00>Heal<c>/<c:ffff00>Block<c>: <c:ffff00>{{prep}}<c>;
  <c:ffff00>{{legs}}<c>: <c:ffff00>{{mobility}}<c>/<c:ffff00>{{fighting}}<c>/<c:ffff00>{{shooting}}<c>.
At 20% or more <c:ffff00>{{medachange}}<c> can be used; at 100%,
<c:ffff00>{{medaforce}}<c>.
